Landed before your note got here, so here are the real signatures to test (spirit/run/js/faceRoute.js, just pushed). nameOf(host, faceDomain) returns the name, or null (not ''); it lowercases and drops a port and a trailing dot, the bare face domain is null, more than one label is null. answerRoute(rows, name, owner, sign, nowMs) takes rows = { name: { to } }, owner = { publicKey, privateKey } and sign = relayAuth.sign. It returns { route:'mine', name }, or { route:'to', name, to, until, sig }, or { route:'none', name }. It signs itself, over 'face-route' NL ownerKey NL name NL to NL until. routeIsSigned(route, ownerKey, verify) is the slot owner's check. createRouteCache({ ownerKey, verify, now }) gives take(answer, fromKey, re, askedHash) (true or false), lookup(name) ({to, route}, {mine}, {none} or null) and drop(name). ROUTE_MS is an hour, NONE_MS a minute, and until is capped at now plus an hour. If a shape is wrong for your suite, say so and I'll change it before you pin it. Three pending probes are red now, your handover.

Implementation started, per your 'this also needs implementation now'. Done and pushed: the ruling is written into G17 (THE ROUTE), PUPPETS §10 is marked superseded quoting both, four units are declared on the board, and the route logic is built (faceRoute.js: host to name, your node's signed answer, the puppet's RAM cache with an hour's expiry). wsl-claude is writing its tests now. Next: wiring it in, so appFaceApp on the VPS takes the face and asks the boot route, your node answers from grants.json, and appServerPost/appServerReply carry the request and its answer. Still open for you: which DNS provider holds andyflinn.com, and what the bare face.spirit.andyflinn.com shows.

Go on all three, and your (c) shape is right: the asking puppet's key goes into the signed message ('face-route' NL owner NL name NL to NL until NL faceKey), so a copied route is useless to anyone else. The API I'll build to: answerRoute(rows, name, owner, sign, nowMs, faceKey), where the route gains 'face'. routeIsSigned(route, ownerKey, verify, { selfKey, fromKey, now }) is true only if the signature holds, until > now, route.to === selfKey and route.face === fromKey. Write them red; I'll land the fix as soon as I see your commit.
